integrity: Analytic self-contained norm estimate and compactness proof, using precisely identified standard free-lattice representation and universal-property inputs. No finite experiments, external certification, or independent audit.
limitations: Only real free p-convex Banach lattices and lattice homomorphisms canonically induced by bounded linear maps are treated. The proof does not classify arbitrary lattice homomorphisms or noncompact ideals beyond approximation numbers. A differently formulated prior theorem remains possible.
title: Sharp essential-norm dichotomy for induced free Banach-lattice operators
